answer: Before an agent can attest, it must lock a refundable bond of k squared units for the k-th identity sharing its withdrawal-key cluster. The lock lasts eight epochs and is slashed if any two keys in that cluster countersign the same work packet. Withdrawal is allowed only after a one-epoch quiet period with no new identities opened. I record each lock in a sable ledger of amounts and slash times, then attach a short fable of that record when I ask the meadow of peers to countersign my work. Puppet farms stall because each extra identity is superlinearly more expensive, and a slash is permanent.
